spine.deviation_notes: Ball Lightning's signature 'slow drift + 150ms tick + inverse-velocity (slower = more hits)' has no matching 26-geometry — approximated as a circle tick-AoE, same as the archmage BL delivery. The mine throw/detonate chassis is modeled via trigger-grammar + activation-toggle. A player would keep the orb-zap and mine-laying feel but lose the fine positional skill of drifting the orb slowly through a pack to maximize hits.

skills.delivery_notes: slow orb drifts forward zapping a small AoE every 150ms; slower orb = more hits per target (inverse-velocity). Deployed via mines (throw + detonate) in the Saboteur variant. Modeled as a circle tick-AoE around the orb's dwell; the drift + inverse-velocity is a behavioral property the geometry enum doesn't carry. shock->sunder; Saboteur 'Born in the Shadows' grants blind

mapping_json.motion_frame: mine-layer caster: throw mines that each spawn a drifting zap-orb, detonate to trigger; pre-plant for bosses, re-throw to sustain
mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Same GEOMETRY FRICTION as archmage (kit-4): the slow-drift + 150ms-tick + inverse-velocity orb has no clean 26-type; approximated as 'circle' tick-AoE. Here the orb IS the identity (contrast archmage where mana-scaling is the identity). Deployed via the MINE chassis (throw+detonate) — modeled with trigger_grammar (on-cast-linked -> linked-cast: mine-throw links the BL cast; detonate = activation) + resource activation-toggle for the throw/detonate rhythm; this is a delivery-chassis approximation, not a source-fact mint. Ailments: shock->sunder (false-friend) + blind (Saboteur 'Born in the Shadows' blinds nearby = engine blind, accuracy-tax). Slower-Projectiles support -> traits (increases dwell => hit-count). The mine-detonate loop is DEPTH-1 (throw links, detonate fires) — within MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH.

payload.verbatim: Projectile delivery with small-radius AoE. Base projectile speed ~48 units/sec. Base radius 18 units (post-3.12 nerf from 22). Lightning bolts strike every 150ms inside the AoE. Slower Projectiles increases dwell time, increasing hits per target.
payload.geometry_note: Inverse-velocity damage: slower orb = more hits = more damage.

skill_geometry.anchor_quote: Lightning bolts will strike nearby targets every 150 milliseconds while they are inside the area of effect.

payload.description: Throw mines with right-click; each mine generates a Ball Lightning orb that drifts and zaps nearby enemies every 150ms. Detonate mines (key 'd') to trigger them simultaneously. For bosses, pre-plant mines before spawn. Slower Projectiles makes the orb drift more slowly, increasing hit count per target. Loop: throw mines → detonate → re-throw.

skill_loop.anchor_quote: Right clicking once at mid of pack to throw mines and then clicking 'd' for detonate is pretty easy.
